review.summary: No BLOCKER or MAJOR in the test. The 90% and 7-day assertions now target the rule paragraph, and the stripped-paragraph check correctly excludes it from the number scan. One real test-validity defect: the section-end delimiter does not match the current render, so the extracted "section" is not bounded to the core-metric section. Two smaller hygiene or strength gaps. No product-copy or calculation concerns; the rule text matches the asserted substrings.

findings.file: LiveAnalyticsPage test (it.each 'keeps unsupported core metrics unavailable')
findings.issue: The section is cut with split('<div class="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-5">')[0], but the current render's grid div has className "mt-3 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-5". The delimiter never matches, so split returns the whole remainder of the page and `section` is everything after the section opening tag, not just the core-metric section. If the delimiter did match, [0] would be the content before the grid, which excludes the cards, so the label, 尚不可計算 and value assertions would fail. The extraction is wrong in both cases.
findings.evidence: Test delimiter: `<div class="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-5">`. Render: `<div className="mt-3 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-5">`. Per the stated intent the section should contain the cards, so [0] of a split at the grid start is also the wrong half.
findings.impact: The blanket no-metric-numbers and exactly-5 尚不可計算 assertions run over the entire rest of the page (the trailing page content is not excluded, e.g. other analytics panels), not the intended section. This makes the test fragile: it can false-fail on unrelated page percentages or seconds, or false-pass on content outside the section. The claim of being scoped to the section is not achieved.
findings.recommended_fix: Extract the section by its own boundaries, e.g. html.split(openTag)[1]?.split('</section>')[0], or use a regex like /<section[^>]*aria-labelledby="core-metric-availability-title"[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/section>/. Do not depend on the grid's class string.
findings.required_test: After extraction, assert that section contains the heading 場次核心指標, does not contain content from other page sections (a known string from a neighboring panel), and still contains all 5 cards.

findings.issue: The 'no activity' scenario calls mockReset().mockResolvedValue(...) on shared mocks and never restores them. Later tests in the same file inherit the empty-activity mocks unless a beforeEach/afterEach re-seeds them. The 'existing activity' scenario relies on default mock state with no explicit setup.
findings.evidence: `mocks.analyticsFindMany.mockReset().mockResolvedValue([]); mocks.formSubmissionCount.mockReset().mockResolvedValue(0);` is done conditionally inside the test body, and no restore is shown.
findings.impact: Order-dependent failures or silently weaker later tests. Cannot be confirmed without the rest of the file.
findings.recommended_fix: Seed both mocks explicitly in every scenario, with distinct non-empty data for 'existing activity', and/or reset them in beforeEach. Confirm the file already does so.
findings.required_test: Run the file with the it.each cases ordered last and first (or with --sequence.shuffle) and confirm that the other tests in the file behave the same.

findings.issue: The numeric guard only matches `\d+(\.\d+)?(%| 秒)`. Count or duration formats outside the rule paragraph, such as `12 人`, `3 分鐘`, `0 次`, `1:30` or `7 天`, would pass a blanket 'no metric numbers' claim.
findings.evidence: Regex: /\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:%| 秒)/ applied to the section with the rule paragraph removed.
findings.impact: A future regression that renders a count or minutes value in a card would not be caught. The per-card value check (metricValues equal 尚不可計算 x5) still covers the value slot, so the residual risk is only in the reason text.
findings.recommended_fix: Broaden to /\d/ on the stripped section (the h2/h3/p copy has no digits), or add units 人|分鐘|分|次|天 to the pattern.
findings.required_test: Stripped section contains no digit characters, or inject a fake `3 分鐘` reason and confirm the test fails.
